author: cinammoncroc000
body:
Hello everyone. I tried to create a map that focused on a simple map layout and a unique block palette. Unfortunately, it didn't quite turn out to what I wanted it to be. Instead of scrapping it, however, I decided to turn to you guys to see what I could improve on.
I designed and constructed the map, with help from yellow66 and andee88.

Full Imgur Album: http://imgur.com/a/Ut84C#0

Some Screenshots:






Anticipated loadout set:
  • Dyed Leather Armor, Full Set (Lime and Orange) [Drops disabled]
  • Stone Sword [Drops disabled]
  • Bow with 64 arrows [Bow Drops Disabled, Arrow Drops Enabled]
  • Diamond Pickaxe (Efficiency I) [Drops disabled]
  • 3 Golden Apples [Drops Enabled]
  • 64 of either Lime or Orange wool [Drops Enabled]
  • 64 of Spruce Wood Logs [Drops Enabled]
  • 64 of Normal Glass [Drops Enabled]
  • Points Shop [Drops Disabled]
I'll try and write the YML file myself, however if you are able to write it for me that would be greatly appreciated.

Any suggestions and constructive criticism are appreciated and encouraged, as I know that this map is definitely not perfect and probably needs a lot of work .-.

replies.author: cinammoncroc000
replies.body:
I should probably relay some additional information:
  • Iron is located in the four towers near spawn, as well as around the ring. A problem I foresee is that there is not enough iron...
  • Inside the chests, there are fishing rods, swiftness/slowness potions, enchanted golden swords, and arrows. Look at the imgur album to see them.
  • The monument islands are raised 10 blocks above the mainland. I did this to add a bit of challenge in terms of getting to it.
  • There is one block under the monument islands that you can dig through and break the monument (basically, there's no bedrock there.)
  • Crafting tables are located next to the iron mines in the outer ring.
That's all I can think of for now...
